def write_glb(path, positions, normals, uvs, indices, material):
    """One static mesh with one material slot; positions and normals in Blender axes (metres)."""
    p = np.asarray(positions, np.float32); n = np.asarray(normals, np.float32); t = np.asarray(uvs, np.float32)
    i = np.asarray(indices, np.uint32).reshape(-1)
    gl = lambda v: np.stack([v[:, 0], v[:, 2], -v[:, 1]], 1).astype(np.float32)
    p, n = gl(p), gl(n)
    n /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(n, axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-9)
    chunks, views, accessors = bytearray(), [], []

    def add(array, kind, ctype, target, minmax=False):
        chunks.extend(b'\x00' * (-len(chunks) % 4))
        views.append({'buffer': 0, 'byteOffset': len(chunks), 'byteLength': array.nbytes, 'target': target})
        chunks.extend(array.tobytes())
        acc = {'bufferView': len(views) - 1, 'componentType': ctype, 'count': len(array), 'type': kind}
        if minmax:
            acc['min'] = [float(v) for v in array.min(0)]; acc['max'] = [float(v) for v in array.max(0)]
        accessors.append(acc)
        return len(accessors) - 1

    attributes = {'POSITION': add(p, 'VEC3', 5126, 34962, True), 'NORMAL': add(n, 'VEC3', 5126, 34962),
                  'TEXCOORD_0': add(t, 'VEC2', 5126, 34962)}
    index = add(i, 'SCALAR', 5125, 34963)
    gltf = {'asset': {'version': '2.0', 'generator': 'yorimichi hippodrome'}, 'scene': 0,
            'scenes': [{'nodes': [0]}], 'nodes': [{'name': path.stem, 'mesh': 0}],
            'meshes': [{'name': path.stem, 'primitives': [{'attributes': attributes, 'indices': index, 'material': 0}]}],
            'materials': [{'name': material, 'pbrMetallicRoughness': {'baseColorFactor': [.8, .8, .8, 1.],
                                                                       'metallicFactor': 0., 'roughnessFactor': .9}}],
            'buffers': [{'byteLength': len(chunks)}], 'bufferViews': views, 'accessors': accessors}
    _save(path, gltf, chunks)
    return {'triangles': len(i) // 3, 'min': [float(v) for v in np.asarray(positions).min(0)],
            'max': [float(v) for v in np.asarray(positions).max(0)], 'material': material}

def _save(path, gltf, binary):
    binary = bytes(binary) + b'\x00' * (-len(binary) % 4)
    gltf['buffers'] = [{'byteLength': len(binary)}]
    text = json.dumps(gltf, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    text += b' ' * (-len(text) % 4)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(struct.pack('<III', 0x46546C67, 2, 12 + 8 + len(text) + 8 + len(binary)) +
                     struct.pack('<II', len(text), 0x4E4F534A) + text + struct.pack('<II', len(binary), 0x004E4942) + binary)

def paint_join(path, mesh):
    """@cc [owner:fontanierh,label:correctness] country-earthworks-colour-frame
    Railway colour blending MUST compare carved and natural heights in the same
    world frame. Unchanged ground MUST retain its forest or shoreline palette.
    """
    points = np.asarray(mesh.p) + L.ORIGIN
    # The inner rim keeps the four-layer palette at the actual terrain triangles.
    x = np.clip(points[:, 0], L.BOUNDS[0], L.BOUNDS[2]) - L.ORIGIN[0]
    y = np.clip(points[:, 1], L.BOUNDS[1], L.BOUNDS[3]) - L.ORIGIN[1]
    colours = source.terrain_colours().colour(x, y)
    assert np.isfinite(colours).all(), 'Missing valley colour at the terrain join'
    weight = forest_weight(points[:, 0], points[:, 1])
    # All exterior edges share the forest-floor palette. The mountain material
    # reaches this same palette along its northern edge, including the corners.
    ox = np.clip(points[:, 0], terrain.OUTER[0], terrain.OUTER[2])
    oy = np.clip(points[:, 1], terrain.OUTER[1], terrain.OUTER[3])
    outer = far_palette(ox, oy)
    colours = colours*(1.-weight[:, None]) + outer*weight[:, None]
    if path.stem == 'SM_BM_NorthCountry':
        colours = far_palette(points[:,0],points[:,1])
        colours = shorelines.colours(points[:,0],points[:,1],points[:,2],
                                     np.asarray(mesh.n)[:,2],colours)
    if getattr(mesh, 'natural', None) is not None:      # the railway's cuttings and banks (train/earthworks.py)
        from train import earthworks
        colours = earthworks.paint(colours, points[:, 0], points[:, 1], points[:, 2], mesh.natural)
    rgba = np.c_[source.srgb(colours), weight].astype('<f4')
    doc, binary = glb_parts(path.read_bytes())
    assert doc['accessors'][doc['meshes'][0]['primitives'][0]['attributes']['POSITION']]['count'] == len(rgba)
    doc['bufferViews'].append({'buffer': 0, 'byteOffset': len(binary), 'byteLength': rgba.nbytes, 'target': 34962})
    doc['accessors'].append({'bufferView': len(doc['bufferViews'])-1, 'componentType': 5126, 'count': len(rgba), 'type': 'VEC4'})
    doc['meshes'][0]['primitives'][0]['attributes']['COLOR_0'] = len(doc['accessors'])-1
    binary += rgba.tobytes(); doc['buffers'][0]['byteLength'] = len(binary)
    path.write_bytes(glb_pack(doc, binary))
